name: Stillforge
look: a towering copper-and-brass pot-still automaton: a riveted copper belly with a glowing firebox, a swan-neck arm arching into a coiled condenser, pipe arms and piston legs, venting steam
entry: Engineered by master craftsmen, Stillforge boils impure water inside its copper belly and condenses it into pure, elemental energy.
how: Evolve Alembix at level 42 with a Fire-type Pokémon in the party.
Wild: rare in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
